alias: Music: skip anything on the block list
description: Whenever a Music Assistant speaker starts a song, it is checked against Ty's block list (todo.music_block_list, open items) and skipped at once if it matches, whatever started it: Claude, radio mode, a playlist or the Music pop-up. 'Title — Artist' (or 'Title - Artist') blocks a song: same title once brackets like (feat. ...) and ' - Remastered' are dropped, and that artist among the song's artists. A bare name blocks the artist. While the Whole House group plays, its Kitchen and HomePod members are ignored so the group skips once. Script music_block (the voice agent's Block song tool) adds to the list. Ty, 2026-11-04.

variables.hit: {% macro norm(s) %}{{ s | lower | regex_replace('\s*[\(\[][^\)\]]*[\)\]]', '') | regex_replace('\s+-\s+.*$', '') | regex_replace('[^a-z0-9 ]', '') | regex_replace('\s+', ' ') | trim }}{% endmacro %}{% set t = norm(state_attr(trigger.entity_id, 'media_title') or '') | trim %}{% set names = (state_attr(trigger.entity_id, 'media_artist') or '') | lower | regex_replace('\s*(/|,|&|;| feat\.? | ft\.? | x | and | with )\s*', '|') | regex_replace('[^a-z0-9 |]', '') | regex_replace('\s+', ' ') %}{% set names = names.split('|') | map('trim') | reject('eq', '') | list %}{% set ns = namespace(hit='') %}{% for i in list['todo.music_block_list']['items'] %}{% set s = i.summary %}{% set sep = ' — ' if ' — ' in s else (' - ' if ' - ' in s else '') %}{% if sep %}{% set it = norm(s.split(sep, 1)[0]) | trim %}{% set ia = norm(s.split(sep, 1)[1]) | trim %}{% if ns.hit == '' and it == t and ia in names %}{% set ns.hit = s %}{% endif %}{% else %}{% if ns.hit == '' and (norm(s) | trim) in names %}{% set ns.hit = s %}{% endif %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ ns.hit }}
